verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents an Editor API for "automating and extending" the Editor, a REST API, and an MCP server that connects AI assistants to an open Editor session. None of these is a product-provided facility for configuring automations that run autonomously in the background, such as schedules, triggers or unattended agents. The Editor API and REST API are developer building blocks, and the MCP server needs a live Editor session driven by an external assistant, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
